evidence: The nitrogen incorporation and binding structure were studied using X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The interfacial and electrical properties of PE–ALD HfO2 and HfOxNy were studied using various electrical measurement techniques including capacitance-voltage (C-V), current-voltage (I-V), and voltage stress test. The growth rates were determined by ellipsometry. The stoichiometry, impurity contents, and chemical binding structures were analyzed by XPS.
